# NarrativeStatementField

One sentence, centred, over a dot field.

## When to use it

One sentence marking the turn between two arguments. A breath, not a point.

## Shape

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | A-narrative |
| Form | statement |
| Arity | 1 |
| Ground | cream |
| Density | airy, about 60 characters |
| Media | motif |
| Focal | statement at 104px against a 64px headline (ratio 1.63) |

## Why it holds together

Against the deck's normal headline, since this slide has none of its own. The statement IS the headline, at poster scale.

# NarrativePanelModel

A long argument on tinted ground, beside its model.

## When to use it

A position needing three or four hundred words, with the model it rests on visible alongside.

## Shape

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | A-narrative (secondary F-relational) |
| Form | colour-block |
| Arity | 6 |
| Ground | tint, cream |
| Density | dense, about 1180 characters |
| Media | motif |
| Focal | headline at 56px against a 56px headline (ratio 1.0) |

Flat. Nothing on this slide out-shouts the argument, because the argument is the slide.

# NarrativeTensionSpectrum

Five tensions, each placed on its line.

## When to use it

Tensions rather than choices — and the evidence to say WHERE something sits between two poles.

## Shape

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | A-narrative (secondary E-comparison) |
| Form | index |
| Arity | 5 |
| Ground | cream, navy |
| Density | dense, about 1180 characters |
| Media | photo |
| Focal | quote at 44px against a 52px headline (ratio 0.85) |

## Why it holds together

The quote and the headline are near-peers on purpose: one is the research, the other is what it feels like, and neither outranks the other.

## Related kit layout

`ComparisonV1` — ComparisonV1 offers two boxes, which forces a binary a tension does not have. Nothing in the kit can say 'somewhere along here'.

## Deviations from the traced source

| What | Source | Here | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| headline printing through its own intro | present | fixed | A defect in the source. |
| skewed pull quote | set on a rotation | flat | Unsanctioned by the type system and it costs legibility for nothing. |

## What the consumer supplies

Copy only. The geometry is measured off a real slide, so when you rebuild it in Claude Design Slides keep the positions and sizes in the preview exactly: change the words, not the grid. Build the text and shapes from the Elements cards, each of which ends with its Slides recipe.
